_note: An example state file for state.py (the clean proof) and foreign.py (the foreign-activity check). Write one per box. Paths are relative to $HOME. The sha256 values here are placeholders: put the hashes of your own pinned files. accepted_timers lists the timers a stock Ubuntu server runs; a run of one of them is listed as expected, not foreign. Remove any you do not want to accept.
